prompts.elderly: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a Polish PRL side-scrolling pixel-art game. Generate ONE sprite sheet, exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, 8 full-body sprites, all facing RIGHT in strict side profile. Same elderly Polish woman in every cell: hunched posture, grey hair under a floral headscarf, brown cardigan, muted plum calf-length skirt, dark sensible shoes, shopping bag and wooden walking cane. Clothes from 1970s-1980s Poland. Row 1: four distinct frames of slow walking, alternating feet, cane moving naturally. Row 2: four frames of hurried short steps with same cane and bag, no airborne sprint. Crisp detailed 16-bit pixel art, dark outlines, shaded fabric, character proportions like realistic 46-pixel-tall street pedestrians, no huge heads. Consistent size and foot baseline, generous clear gaps between cells. Transparent background with real alpha; no scenery, no floor, no shadows, no text, no grid. All sprites fully contained. Output a wide sheet.
prompts.mother: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a Polish PRL side-scrolling pixel-art game. Generate ONE sprite sheet, exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, 8 full-body sprites, all facing RIGHT in strict side profile. Row 2: four slightly hurried walking poses, still pushing the pram safely, wheels remain on ground. Crisp detailed 16-bit pixel art with dark outlines and shaded fabrics, realistic adult proportions matching a 46-pixel-tall street pedestrian. Same scale and foot baseline in all frames, enough clear space around all 8 cells, every sprite fully contained. Transparent background with real alpha; no scenery, no floor, no shadows, no text, no grid. Wide landscape atlas.
